scenes.title: Agent 365: pilot the control plane first
scenes.body: Bottom line: use Agent 365 as the control plane for one accountable pilot; verify ownership, access, action traces, licenses, and preview limits before scaling.
scenes.narration: Bottom line: use Agent 365 as the control plane for one accountable pilot; verify ownership, access, action traces, licenses, and preview limits before scaling.
claims: Agent 365 is a centralized control plane for observing, governing, and securing AI agents.
Observation should pair agent inventory with audited traces for interactions, inference events, and tool usage.
Governance and security connect lifecycle controls, Entra permissions, Purview protection, and Defender detection.
SDK integration extends existing agents with enterprise capabilities without creating or hosting the agent.
A pilot must verify prerequisites, licenses, preview limits, and telemetry before scaling.

scenes.title: 2. Observe traced work
